name: Ovi
description: '''Ovidio Crespo Retureta''' (born October 10, 1995), better known by his stage name, '''Ovi''', is a Cuban rapper and singer of [[corrido]], [[Reggaeton|reggaetón]] and [[Latin trap]]. He is part of the Rancho Humilde label and has collaborated with artists such as [[Snoop Dogg]], [[Natanael Cano]], [[Junior H]], and [[Snow Tha Product]].
